# HTTP contract

Teacher-only `GET /internal/students/{studentID}/diagnostic-assessment-plans/{planID}/planning-state`
returns `diagnostic-planning-state.v1`: exact plan ID, binding goal/direction,
onboarding version, and optional request (`request_id`, `status`, optional
`result_code`, `failure_code`, `learning_path_id`). No request omits the member.
Exact owner is checked; foreign plans return 404, ambiguous/conflicting records
409. Query/body are forbidden; responses are no-store. This GET creates no work.

Diagnostic-linked Teacher INITIAL POST requires `Idempotency-Key=diagnostic_plan_id`.
Replay retains one request identity. Only `FAILED/ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED` explicitly
resumes that request. Other failures, COMPLETED and NO_GAP replay unchanged.

Diagnostic initial allocation adds paired `expected_onboarding_version` and
`expected_direction_code`. Student replays its existing request receipt first;
fresh allocation locks and checks authoritative onboarding version/direction/goal.
Its exact plain-text `409 diagnostic_context_stale` becomes permanent
`DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID`, whereas ambiguous transport retries the frozen body.

## API authentication

API routes trust gateway-provided `X-User-ID` and `X-User-Role`. Only `STUDENT` and `STUDENT_PRO` may create or read their planning requests. The service must not be exposed without the trusted gateway boundary.

## Create Course plan

`POST /api/learning-planner/v1/course-plans` requires a UUID `Idempotency-Key` header and body:

```json
{
  "goal_code": "go.backend",
  "desired_outcome": "Build a production Go HTTP API",
  "requested_targets": [
    {"type": "capability", "key": "go.http-service", "version": "v1"}
  ],
  "constraints": {
    "language": "ru",
    "weekly_minutes": 240,
    "preferred_pace": "standard",
    "deadline": "2026-12-01",
    "project_context": "Optional bounded context"
  },
  "reason": "INITIAL"
}
```

`desired_outcome` defaults to `goal_code` for the public Student route.
Requested targets must exist in the published goal graph; Planner includes
their complete transitive prerequisite closure. Callers cannot provide
mastery. `INITIAL` must omit `learning_path_id`; Student allocates a new path
later. `REPLAN` must provide an owned exact path UUID. The path participates in
the idempotency request hash, so the same key cannot be retargeted. A stored
`INITIAL` may expose its resolved path after allocation.

It returns `202` for a new or still-running request, `200` for an idempotent replay of a terminal request, `409` when the same key is reused with a different body, and `422` for invalid input.

## Read Course plan

`GET /api/learning-planner/v1/course-plans/{requestID}` returns only a request owned by the authenticated Student. Responses expose request ID, goal, status, optional result code, optional `course_id`, optional resolved `learning_path_id`, reuse flag, attempts, and timestamps. They never expose normalized planning context, mastery detail, prompt data, or internal failure detail.

## Exact competency resolution

`POST /internal/learning-targets/resolve` requires the exact shared
`X-Internal-Token` and a strict body:

```json
{
  "schema": "learning-target-resolution-request.v1",
  "targets": [
    {"type": "capability", "key": "go.http-service", "version": "v1"}
  ]
}
```

It accepts 1–100 unique exact `(type, key, version)` references and returns
`learning-target-resolution.v1` with `resolved` and `missing` arrays in request
order. Resolution never aliases names, selects a latest version, or derives a
competency from generated text. Unknown fields and malformed identities return
`422`.

`POST /internal/learning-targets/candidates` uses the same general internal
token and accepts `learning-target-candidate-request.v1` with zero to sixteen
normalized stack codes. It returns at most 200 canonical definitions and their
prerequisite identities as `learning-target-candidates.v1`. An empty stack list
returns the bounded catalog vocabulary. This is authoring discovery only: TZ
Planner must still pass every selected identity through exact resolution.

## Teacher delegation and private health

`POST /internal/students/{studentID}/course-plans` requires the exact dedicated
`TEACHER_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN`, a UUID `Idempotency-Key`, and the same planning
intent fields. Bounded `audit_refs` are optional; `source_message_id` requires
its owning `dialog_id`. It records `source=TEACHER` and returns the same
asynchronous status shape. The general internal token is not accepted on this
route.

`POST /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-readiness` uses the same exact
dedicated Teacher token and is separately gated by
`PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED`, which defaults to `false`. The strict body
is capped at 16 KiB:

```json
{
  "schema": "learning-readiness-request.v1",
  "expected_state_ref": {"kind": "accepted_draft", "version": 4}
}
```

`expected_state_ref` is optional; when supplied it must exactly match the
Student snapshot or the request returns `409`. The endpoint accepts no profile,
goal, graph, stack, language, mastery, or content input. It requires no
idempotency key, performs no write, and returns `Cache-Control: no-store`.

Planner reads Student
`GET /internal/students/{studentID}/planning-readiness` under the general read
token and strictly validates `student-planning-readiness-snapshot.v1`. The
result is exact `learning-readiness.v1` with `READY`, `NOT_READY`, or
`NEEDS_CLARIFICATION`, closed reason codes, resolver and Student state
versions, `readiness_scope=PUBLISHED_GRAPH_RESOLUTION`, `executable=false`, and
`content_status=NOT_CREATED`. A `READY` result contains only the exact
published `{code,version,graph_version}`; it never contains a prospective
Course, Learning Path, or Lesson identity. An existing active Student path
wins and is returned unchanged as an observational
`NOT_READY/ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS` reference.

### Durable onboarding plan handoff v1

`POST /internal/students/{studentID}/onboarding-plan-handoffs` requires the
new dedicated `TEACHER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_INTERNAL_TOKEN` and exactly one
byte-canonical UUID `Idempotency-Key` (no whitespace); general, legacy
Teacher, and Practice tokens are rejected.
The request is strict JSON capped at 16 KiB:

```json
{
  "schema": "teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1",
  "expected_state_ref": {"kind": "accepted_draft", "version": 4},
  "dialog_id": "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
  "teacher_job_id": "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
}
```

Planner owns no supplied onboarding facts: it re-reads the authoritative
Student readiness snapshot and accepts only an exact S6 `READY` result whose
state ref matches. First acceptance returns `201`; an exact same-key/hash
replay returns `200` with `replayed=true`. The strict response is
`teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1`:

```json
{
  "schema": "teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1",
  "handoff_id": "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
  "status": "ACCEPTED",
  "state_ref": {"kind": "accepted_draft", "version": 4},
  "goal": {"code": "programming.foundation", "version": "v1", "graph_version": "programming-foundation-graph-v1"},
  "execution_status": "NOT_STARTED",
  "content_status": "NOT_CREATED",
  "readiness_observed_at": "2026-09-11T00:00:00Z",
  "replayed": false
}
```

`PLANNER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_ENABLED=false` is the default. It permits only an
exact durable replay and otherwise returns `503 capability_disabled` before a
Student or graph read. Enabling it requires
`PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED=true`. `409` is `idempotency_conflict`,
`state_changed`, or `active_path_exists`; non-ready/clarification outcomes are
`422 not_ready`. Responses are `application/json` and `Cache-Control: no-store`.
`readiness_observed_at` is the canonical UTC instant when Planner observed the
authoritative readiness result; it is at or before the receipt creation time.
`ACCEPTED` is a historical, non-executable admission at that observation point,
not a reservation or proof that no active path exists now. S9 must re-read and
atomically reserve Student state immediately before any effect. The receipt is
not a planning job and never creates a Course, path, lesson, content, outbox
event, or message.

`GET /internal/health` requires the exact shared `X-Internal-Token` and reports process readiness only.

## Practice learning route and lazy material

The following routes require the exact dedicated
`PRACTICE_TASK_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN`; the general and Teacher tokens are
rejected.

`POST /internal/practice-learning-routes` requires a task-instance UUID
`Idempotency-Key` equal to `task_instance_id` and a strict
`practice-learning-route-request.v1`. It accepts the Student identity, exact
TaskRevision identity/digest, locale, and ordered Step learning requirements.
It returns `201` for the first immutable resolution and `200` for a replay as
`student-task-learning-snapshot.v1`. Reusing the task instance with a different
normalized request returns `409`.

`POST /internal/practice-learning-routes/{routeID}/steps/{stepID}/readiness-reconciliations`
requires the same dedicated token, a canonical UUID `Idempotency-Key`, and a
strict `practice-learning-readiness-reconcile.v1` body with exact TaskInstance,
Student, revision/digest, route/digest, and step identities. Planner loads the
immutable route by ID, reads the Student's current mastery through its Student
adapter, and applies Planner's existing requirement policy. It returns a
persisted `practice-learning-readiness-receipt.v1` with `READY` or `NOT_READY`,
the learner-state digest, mastery-policy version, and observation time. A
same-key/same-payload retry returns the original receipt; changed payload under
the same key returns `409`. Wrong instance, revision, route, or digest is
rejected before a readiness decision is persisted.

`POST /internal/practice-learning-materials/{materialKey}/ensure` requires the
material's deterministic UUID as `Idempotency-Key` and strict
`practice-learning-material-ensure-request.v1` containing `route_id` and
`route_digest`. It returns `practice-learning-material.v1` with the Course-owned
`course_id`/`lesson_id`. A key outside that frozen route is rejected.

## Downstream private contracts

Planner currently expects:

- Student `GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learner-overview`;
- Student `GET /internal/students/{studentID}/planning-readiness`;
- Student `POST /internal/students/{studentID}/mastery/query`;
- Student `PUT /internal/students/{studentID}/courses/{courseID}/assignment`;
- Student `PUT /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-path` only for idempotent new-path allocation, with UUID `planning_request_id` and `Idempotency-Key`; Planner captures the returned path ID/version;
- Student `GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/planning-state` returning `student-learning-path-planning-state.v1`;
- Student `PUT /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}` with strict `student-learning-path-replan.v1` and Student-owned reconciliation;
- Student `PUT /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/completion` with strict `student-learning-path-no-gap.v1`;
- AI Prompt `POST /api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential` with exact template and response schema `course.lesson-content.v1`;
- Course `POST /internal/generated-courses`, an atomic ensure command that reuses the exact fingerprint or creates it once.
- Student `POST /internal/v1/students/{studentID}/diagnostic-assessments/{planID}/reserve` and `GET /internal/v1/students/{studentID}/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/result`; both use the fixed shared `diagnostic-assessment-plan.v1` containing only the agreed bootstrap context fields in addition to the fixed plan.

## Diagnostic bootstrap

`POST /api/learning-planner/v1/diagnostic-assessment-plans` requires a canonical
UUID `Idempotency-Key`, `application/json`, and the strict 16 KiB
`diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap.v1` body. Its response is the no-store
`diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap-result.v1` with only plan/attempt identity,
revision, digest, onboarding version, and creation time. The actor is taken
only from `RequireStudent`; Course, goal, direction, task, score, band, and
placement fields are rejected. The former raw private issue route is not
registered. Teacher's private aggregate-only placement routes remain unchanged.

Teacher's private Course-plan command may include optional `diagnostic_plan_id`
only for `INITIAL`. Planner validates immutable ownership, current onboarding,
binding, and placement before normal planning; the ID is never returned in a
Course-plan response, event, Course/Student payload, or path command.

Practice materialization uses the same Course command with one complete active
Lesson and fingerprint version `practice-material-fingerprint-v1`; route
resolution itself makes no Course or AI call.

Student reads use Student's general internal token. Student assignment/path
writes use a separate dedicated Learning Planner token; one credential cannot
be configured for both contours. Course writes use Course's dedicated Learning
Planner token. A general internal or Teacher-facing token is rejected by write
routes. Exact path identity is carried by the URL and is deliberately omitted
from the strict replan/completion JSON body. Both commands use the planning
request UUID as `planning_request_id` and `Idempotency-Key`, and return bounded
`student-learning-path-command-result.v1`. Planner persists the immutable
normalized body, expected path version, exact identities, and semantic hash
before the PUT. After transport ambiguity it repeats that checkpoint without
rereading path state. Its private planned outcome is not returned as
`result_code`, `course_id`, or `reused` until Student success is confirmed. A
delivered Student `409` is terminal
`LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_CONFLICT`, not retryable; malformed or cross-path
receipts terminate as `LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_INVALID_RESPONSE`.

The generated Course document is limited to 16 MiB after JSON serialization.
Planner rejects an oversized draft before calling Course. Worker claims are
renewed before every bounded downstream generation/read/write operation, and
`WORKER_LEASE_TTL` must exceed the downstream HTTP timeout.
The owning Student and Course repositories contain the corresponding additive
contracts, but their migrations and deployment configuration must be rolled out before this service.

## Teacher project authoring flow

These dedicated-Teacher routes are not public: create at
`POST /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/project-authoring-flows`,
current recovery at `GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/project-authoring-flows/current`,
owner-scoped read at `GET /internal/students/{studentID}/project-authoring-flows/{flowID}`,
and schema-only `POST .../{flowID}/confirm` and `POST .../{flowID}/publish`.
Every command requires its own canonical UUID `Idempotency-Key` and strict
`application/json`. Unknown ownership, Course, target, profile/mastery, runtime,
Sandbox, or Start fields are rejected.

Create derives the exact current path snapshot, authoring-profile version/digest,
and bounded TZ v2 request from Student owner state. Confirmation makes the durable flow worker-eligible.
Current recovery accepts no query or body, reloads that same current selected ACTIVE owner state, and returns only a non-FAILED flow with every frozen path/profile provenance field equal; it returns 404 when no such flow exists.
Every create, current, get, confirm, and publish `project-authoring-flow.v1`
response also contains required `locale`, the exact `en` or `ru` already frozen
in the immutable validated `Input.Locale`; the response never recalculates it
from a profile and never accepts it from the caller.
Verified TZ READY output is submitted through `/stage`, returning STAGED and a private staging receipt. The publish command returns conflict until Practice acceptance and publication have an implemented proof contract. The safe response contains owner provenance, digests and staging receipt; authored content and private verifier data remain excluded.

The dedicated TZ client disables redirects, caps request results, requires JSON,
rejects unknown job/receipt fields, and verifies blueprint and verification
receipt digests. A lost create is recovered by exact POST replay; a checkpointed
404 is accepted only when that replay returns the identical TZ job UUID. No
Planner port exists for Practice Start or Sandbox creation.

Lesson assignment cutover adds `lesson_revision_id` to Course ensure lesson
bindings and forwards it in Student allocation/replan items and onboarding
materialization lessons. Student planning-state items additionally carry optional
`learning_path_item_id`; Planner preserves exact existing assignment identities.
Frozen requirements remain Student-owned and absent from Planner commands.


Project authoring staging lifecycle: verified TZ READY candidates are submitted through `POST /internal/v1/authoring-jobs/{id}/stage`. Planner validates the exact `practice-task-staging-receipt.v1`, job identity, candidate/blueprint digests and verified artifact digests, then durably records `STAGED` and the immutable receipt. Staging creates no public revision. The existing Planner `/publish` command fails closed for generated, READY and STAGED candidates because Practice-owned acceptance and post-acceptance publication integration are deferred. Historical publication receipts remain readable; staging never writes a publication receipt or PUBLISHED.
